name: DARRP Restoration Implementation Grants
summary: Large multi-year cooperative agreements from NOAA's Damage Assessment, Remediation and Restoration Program for organisations that select, run and oversee many coastal and marine habitat restoration projects paid for by oil spill and pollution damage settlements.

pool.note: Anticipated, for the initial cooperative agreements

reporting: Recipients send financial and performance reports twice a year, on 30 October and 30 April, and a final report covering the whole award within 120 days of its end.

status.quote: Applications must be postmarked, provided to a delivery service, or received by www.grants.gov by 11:59 PM EST on November 18th, 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications must be postmarked, provided to a delivery service, or received by www.grants.gov by 11:59 PM EST on November 18th, 2026.

administered_by.quote: These Restoration Implementation Grants will be administered by the NOAA Restoration Center: https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/topic/habitat-conservation/how-we-restore.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants are institutions of higher education, non-profits, and commercial (for-profit) organizations. Applications from federal, state, or tribal governments will not be considered, due to their potential role as trustee council members.

access.quote: Applicants should apply through the Grants.gov website (www.grants.gov).

window.quote: Applications must be submitted by the due date and time provided in Section IV.D. Late applications will not be considered for funding.

amount.quote: NOAA does not anticipate accepting applications requesting less than $2.5 million or more than $100 million in federal funds from NOAA under this solicitation.

pool.quote: Total anticipated funding for initial cooperative agreements under this competition is up to $100 million.

co_finance_required.quote: Cost Share or Matching Requirement Matching funds are not required.

reporting.quote: financial reports are to be submitted semiannually on Oct. 30 and April 30 and performance (technical) reports are to be submitted on the same schedule as financial reports
